title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: Monitoring a candidate building block during assembly can guide reaction-condition changes toward a target high-nuclearity cluster.
explanation: In the Eu–Ti wheel example, time-dependent spectra implicated rapidly formed Eu3Ti units in subsequent growth, while temperature-dependent spectra helped identify conditions favoring the Eu24Ti8 product and its crystallization.
scope: The wheel-like Eu24Ti8 lanthanide–titanium cluster system.
conditions: Time- and temperature-dependent high-resolution ESI-MS; higher reaction temperatures favored the reported stable wheel.
caveats: The temperature effect and identified precursor are demonstrated for this system and should not be generalized to all lanthanide clusters.
